Build the feature × compound evaluation table

build_eval_full.Rd

Joins the MS1Match's tier-annotated feature-compound summary onto the CAMERA annotated feature table, so every row carries both the MS1Match annotation tier and the CAMERA pcgroup / adduct assignments.

Usage

build_eval_full(feature_compound_summary, CAMERA_ft)

Arguments

feature_compound_summary

data.frame. The export_feature_compound_summary element of join_annotation_results(). Must contain: feature_name, Compound_name, reference_tier, annotation_phase, Lib_group, adduct_match, rt.

CAMERA_ft

data.frame. CAMERA-annotated feature table (e.g. CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT_sub). Must contain: feature_name, pcgroup, adduct (CAMERA's adduct/isotope string), mz.

Value

A data.frame with one row per feature × compound combination, containing all MS1Match annotation columns plus CAMERA's pcgroup, adduct (renamed CAMERA_adduct), and mz.
